newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products flat to off in lacklustre trade.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products flat to off in lacklustre trade.

text.p: NWE oil products were steady to weaker on Thursday, traders said.
Fuel oil prices remained static looking for fresh direction and largely ignored a further dip in crude prices. High sulphur barges traded at $86, $85 and $84.50 fob ARA.
Gasoline was slightly weaker in line with crude and slack demand amid healthy stocks. Eurograde barges traded at $195 fob ARA. Naphtha was also slightly weaker.
Gas oil fell $2 on weaker futures, but premiums were unchanged. Dealers said the market was getting some support from Asia. EN590 or diesel cargoes edged up to April IPE +$10.50.
